cases.title: National Tech Fest Participation & Growth Crisis

scenario.context: A premier engineering university is organizing its annual flagship 3-day tech symposium in exactly 30 days. The festival faces severe participation risk and low early buzz.

metrics.marketConstraint: Two rival college fests overlap on the exact same weekend.

requiredPillars: 1. Target Audience Segmentation & High-Conversion Student Personas
2. Zero-Cost & Low-Cost Guerrilla Marketing Strategy
3. High-Conversion Content, Reel & Discord Viral Campaign Plan
4. Campus Ambassador Network & Referral Incentive Mechanics
5. Granular INR Budget Allocation Matrix with Contingency Buffer
6. 30-Day Day-by-Day Milestone Gantt Roadmap (Tease -> Blitz -> Conversion -> Last-mile)
7. Gamified Student Engagement Funnel & Exclusive Ticket Unlock Perks
8. Measurable Conversion Funnel KPIs & Stage Benchmarks
9. High-Stakes Risk Mitigation & Crisis Management Matrix
10. Projected ROI, Revenue Model & Attendance Conversion Projections

bombs.headline: 🚨 CRITICAL BUDGET SLASH: ₹15,000 ➔ ₹3,000!
bombs.description: The student council treasury just froze funds! Your total marketing budget is slashed from ₹15,000 down to ₹3,000. All paid ads and print banners are immediately revoked.
bombs.directive: Pivot immediately to zero-cost growth hacking, viral WhatsApp squad tickets, and peer-to-peer Discord bounties.

bombs.headline: 🚨 SCHEDULE EMERGENCY: 30 DAYS ➔ 15 DAYS!
bombs.description: Due to university semester exam rescheduling, the festival date has been moved forward by 15 days! You only have 15 days remaining.
bombs.directive: Compress all rollout phases into an immediate 15-day blitz, prioritizing high-velocity flash campaigns over slow awareness funnels.

bombs.headline: 🚨 DEMOGRAPHIC PIVOT: EXPAND TO INDUSTRY & ALUMNI!
bombs.description: University trustees mandate opening the flagship competitions to working junior software developers and tech alumni, not just undergraduates.
bombs.directive: Pivot brand tone, prize incentives, networking value proposition, and communication channels toward working engineers and alumni.

cases.title: Hyperlocal EV Fleet Subscription Launch Crisis

scenario.context: A green-mobility startup is launching a peer-to-peer electric two-wheeler subscription service in a tier-2 college town with severe range anxiety and skeptical consumers.
requiredPillars: 1. Brand Positioning & Overcoming Consumer Range Anxiety
2. Hyperlocal Campus & Tech Park Activation Blitz
3. Tiered Subscription Pricing & Security Deposit Mechanics
4. Battery Swap Network SLA & Fleet Operations Protocol
5. Granular Launch Budget Allocation Matrix
6. 4-Week Phased Rollout Roadmap & T-Minus Checklist
7. Referral Loops & Gamified Clean-Kilometer Rewards
8. Unit Economics (CAC, LTV, Fleet Utilization Rate) KPIs
9. Emergency Vehicle Breakdown & Power Contingency SLA
10. 90-Day Expansion & Investor Milestone Projections

bombs.headline: 🚨 POWER GRID HALT: 6 OUT OF 8 HUBS BLOCKED!
bombs.description: Municipal electrical permit delays have halted 6 out of your 8 planned swap hubs! You must launch with only 2 operational hubs.
bombs.directive: Deploy mobile battery swap vans, restructure delivery geofences, and launch rapid on-demand swap dispatch protocols.

bombs.headline: 🚨 CAPITAL CRUNCH: ₹50,000 ➔ ₹10,000!
bombs.description: Angel investor tranche delayed! Your launch budget is compressed from ₹50,000 to ₹10,000.
bombs.directive: Replace expensive offline experiential marketing with viral campus test-ride challenges and peer referral discounts.

bombs.headline: 🚨 MONSOON FLOODING: 40% OF SERVICE AREA WATERLOGGED!
bombs.description: Unseasonal severe monsoons have flooded main university arterial roads, raising water-damage battery fears.
bombs.directive: Implement water-ingress safety certifications, launch complimentary rain-gear add-ons, and dynamic flood-safe routing.

scenario.context: A venture-funded quick-commerce platform is expanding into a dense metro quadrant by deploying 6 automated micro-fulfillment dark stores targeting high basket-size households.
requiredPillars: 1. Hyperlocal Demographic Mapping & High-AOV Category Mix
2. 10-Minute Dark Store Picking & Packing Assembly SLA
3. First-Order Viral Acquisition Hook & Referral Mechanics
4. Rider Dispatch Optimization & Safety-First Route Protocols
5. Granular ₹1,50,000 Budget Allocation & Burn Schedule
6. 60-Day Phased Scale Roadmap (Alpha -> Hub Rollout -> Scale)
7. Gamified Customer Retention & Free-Delivery Subscription Tiers
8. Unit Economics (Contribution Margin per Order) Scorecard
9. Extreme Rush Hour & Inventory Stockout Contingency Plan
10. 90-Day Breakeven & Dark-Store EBITDA Projections

bombs.headline: 🚨 FLEET STRIKE: 70% OF GIG RIDERS WALK OUT!
bombs.description: Rider union announces sudden protest over fuel surge, halting 56 out of 80 delivery riders across all hubs!
bombs.directive: Introduce micro-zone customer self-pickup curbside lockers with 25% instant discounts and optimize remaining riders on clustered drop routes.

bombs.headline: 🚨 COLD-CHAIN DISASTER: 3 DARK STORES LOSE POWER!
bombs.description: Transformer blowout destroys refrigeration across 3 key dark stores, threatening ₹60,000 in perishable inventory.
bombs.directive: Launch a flash 2-hour 'Zero-Waste Megadeal' clearance blitz to liquidate perishables immediately while rerouting dry orders.

bombs.headline: 🚨 COMPETITOR ATTACK: RIVAL LAUNCHES 60% CASHBACK!
bombs.description: A well-funded rival launches an aggressive 60% cashback blitz in your exact service zones.
bombs.directive: Pivot from price wars to superior product exclusivity (fresh artisan bakery, localized specialty items) and guaranteed sub-10 minute reliability.

scenario.context: A digital neo-bank is launching a zero-annual-fee micro-credit wallet designed specifically for college students with zero credit history, utilizing alternative campus transaction scores.

metrics.regulatoryRequirement: Mandatory digital KYC & RBI lending guidelines

requiredPillars: 1. Responsible Financial Brand Persona & Financial Literacy Framing
2. Campus Brand Ambassador Network & Society Sponsorships
3. Frictionless Digital Onboarding & KYC Experience Design
4. Alternative Underwriting & Default Risk Mitigation Rules
5. Granular ₹75,000 Growth Budget Allocation Matrix
6. 45-Day Phased Launch Gantt (Closed Beta -> Multi-Campus Blitz)
7. Gamified Credit-Score Building & Timely-Repayment Rewards
8. Unit Economics (CAC, Repayment Velocity, NPA Rate) Scorecard
9. Delinquency Management & Ethical Recovery Safeguards
10. 12-Month Neo-Bank Expansion & Merchant Ecosystem Roadmap

bombs.headline: 🚨 REGULATORY MANDATE: PHYSICAL BIOMETRIC KYC REQUIRED!
bombs.description: Central banking regulator issues sudden guideline mandating in-person biometric verification for all student credit lines, breaking 1-click digital KYC!
bombs.directive: Deploy authorized student ambassador KYC kiosks at campus libraries and partner with campus bookstores for instant in-person verification perks.

bombs.headline: 🚨 DEFAULT SURGE: EARLY DELINQUENCY HITS 18%!
bombs.description: Beta cohort reveals unacceptably high 18% 30-day default rates, threatening institutional credit underwriting lines.
bombs.directive: Tighten initial limits to ₹500 unlockable dynamically with each on-time payment, and introduce squad social-collateral accountability groups.

bombs.headline: 🚨 CAMPUS ACCESS BLOCKED: AUTHORITIES BAN BOOTHS!
bombs.description: College deans ban all external commercial promotional booths and physical flyer distributions on campus grounds.
bombs.directive: Shift 100% of marketing to student developer hackathon sponsorships, online Discord coding bounties, and inter-college gaming tournaments.
